decisions.statement: A global written to and never read is safe to rename.
A read is found in TypeScript by parsing rather than by matching text.
A read in XML is found by matching text.
A name handed to a control registration binds the game to that name.
A registration argument is followed back through module constants.
A constant bound to two different strings is followed nowhere.
A comment in XML has no read.
Dependents are answered in a settled order.

definition: everything reading an addon global, and whether the global may be renamed
